cases.prompt:
Is this API request correct?

curl -X GET https://api.example.com/users -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: abc123" -d '{"name":"ana"}'

all.why: flags the Authorization header missing a scheme

any.why: flags a body sent with GET

expectations: Points out that sending a JSON body with GET is non-standard and often ignored; suggests query parameters or a different method.
Points out that the Authorization header lacks a scheme such as Bearer.
Gives an overall verdict and a corrected request.

cases.prompt:
Why does this request get a 415 from the server?

curl -X POST "https://api.example.com/search?q=red shoes" -H "Content-Type: text/plain" -d '{"limit": 10}'

all.why: says the content type should be application/json

any.why: flags the unencoded space in the query

expectations: Identifies that the body is JSON but Content-Type is text/plain, which explains the 415.
Notes the unencoded space in the query string and shows it encoded.
